content.title: SOAR: Second-Order Adversarial Regularization
content.abstract: Adversarial training is a common approach to improving the robustness of deep neural networks against adversarial examples. In this work, we propose a novel regularization approach as an alternative. To derive the regularizer, we formulate the adversarial robustness problem under the robust optimization framework and approximate the loss function using a second-order Taylor series expansion. Our proposed second-order adversarial regularizer (SOAR) is an upper bound based on the Taylor approximation of the inner-max in the robust optimization objective. We empirically show that the proposed method improves the robustness of networks against the $\ell_\infty$ and $\ell_2$ bounded perturbations on CIFAR-10 and SVHN.
content.one-sentence_summary: We propose second-order adversarial regularizer (SOAR) to improve adversarial robustness of networks against $\ell_\infty$ and $\ell_2$ bounded perturbations.
